{"items": [{"type": "obligation", "text": "A certification under this paragraph is a certification that the school, school board, local educational agency, or other authority with responsibility for administration of the school- (i) is enforcing a policy of Internet safety that includes the operation of a technology protection measure with respect to any of its computers with Internet access that protects against access through such computers to visual depictions that are- (I) obscene; or (II) child pornography; and (ii) is enforcing the operation of such technology protection measure during any use of such computers.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the school, school board, local educational agency, or other authority with responsibility for administration of the school", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "A certification under this paragraph"}, {"type": "obligation", "text": "An administrator, supervisor, or other person authorized by the certifying authority under subparagraph (A)(i) may disable the technology protection measure concerned, during use by an adult, to enable access for bona fide research or other lawful purpose.", "force": "permission", "binds": "An administrator, supervisor, or other person authorized by the certifying authority", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null}, {"type": "obligation", "text": "Subject to clause (ii) in the case of any school covered by this paragraph as of the effective date of this paragraph under section 1721(h) of the Children's Internet Protection Act, the certification under subparagraphs (B) and (C) shall be made- (I) with respect to the first program funding year under this subsection following such effective date, not later than 120 days after the beginning of such program funding year; and (II) with respect to any subsequent program funding year, as part of the application process for such program funding year.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "any school covered by this paragraph", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "not later than 120 days after the beginning of such program funding year"}, {"type": "obligation", "text": "A school covered by clause (i) that has in place an Internet safety policy and technology protection measures meeting the requirements necessary for certification under subparagraphs (B) and (C) shall certify its compliance with subparagraphs (B) and (C) during each annual program application cycle under this subsection, except that with respect to the first program funding year after the effective date of this paragraph under section 1721(h) of the Children's Internet Protection Act, the certifications shall be made not later than 120 days after the beginning of such first program funding year.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "A school covered by clause (i) that has in place an Internet safety policy and technology protection measures", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "not later than 120 days after the beginning of such first program funding year"}, {"type": "obligation", "text": "A school covered by clause (i) that does not have in place an Internet safety policy and technology protection measures meeting the requirements necessary for certification under subparagraphs (B) and (C)- (aa) for the first program year after the effective date of this subsection in which it is applying for funds under this subsection, shall certify that it is undertaking such actions, including any necessary procurement procedures, to put in place an Internet safety pol icy and technology protection measures meeting the requirements necessary for certification under subparagraphs (B) and (C); and", "force": "obligation", "binds": "A school covered by clause (i) that does not have in place an Internet safety policy and technology protection measures", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "for the first program year after the effective date of this subsection in which it is applying for funds under this subsection"}, {"type": "obligation", "text": "(bb) for the second program year after the effective date of this subsection in which it is applying for funds under this subsection, shall certify that it is in compliance with subparagraphs (B) and (C).", "force": "obligation", "binds": "A school covered by clause (i) that does not have in place an Internet safety policy and technology protection measures", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "for the second program year after the effective date of this subsection in which it is applying for funds under this subsection"}, {"type": "obligation", "text": "Any school that is unable to certify compliance with such requirements in such second program year shall be ineligible for services at discount rates or funding in lieu of services at such rates under this subsection for such second year and all subsequent program years under this subsection, until such time as such school comes into compliance with this paragraph.", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "Any school that is unable to certify compliance with such requirements in such second program year", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "shall be ineligible for services at discount rates or funding in lieu of services at such rates under this subsection for such second year and all subsequent program years"}, {"type": "reference", "text": "section 1721(h) of the Children's Internet Protection Act", "cited_instrument": "Children's Internet Protection Act, section 1721(h)"}]}

{"type": "obligation", "text": "Telecommunications services and network capacity provided to a public institutional telecommunications user under this subsection may not be sold, resold, or otherwise transferred by such user in consideration for money or any other thing of value.", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "such user", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "No entity listed in this subsection shall be entitled to preferential rates or treatment as required by this subsection, if such entity operates as a for-profit business, is a school described in paragraph (7)(A) with an endowment of more than $50,000,000, or is a library or library consortium not eligible for assistance from a State library administrative agency under the Library Services and Technology Act [20 U.S.C. 9121 et seq.].", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "No entity listed in this subsection", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Except as provided in clause (ii), an elementary or secondary school having computers with Internet access may not receive services at discount rates under paragraph (1)(B) unless the school, school board, local educational agency, or other authority with responsibility for administration of the school- (I) submits to the Commission the certifications described in subparagraphs (B) and (C);", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the school, school board, local educational agency, or other authority with responsibility for administration of the school", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "may not receive services at discount rates under paragraph (1)(B)"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Except as provided in clause (ii), an elementary or secondary school having computers with Internet access may not receive services at discount rates under paragraph (1)(B) unless the school, school board, local educational agency, or other authority with responsibility for administration of the school- (II) submits to the Commission a certification that an Internet safety policy has been adopted and implemented for the school under subsection (l); and", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the school, school board, local educational agency, or other authority with responsibility for administration of the school", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "may not receive services at discount rates under paragraph (1)(B)"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Except as provided in clause (ii), an elementary or secondary school having computers with Internet access may not receive services at discount rates under paragraph (1)(B) unless the school, school board, local educational agency, or other authority with responsibility for administration of the school- (III) ensures the use of such computers in accordance with the certifications.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the school, school board, local educational agency, or other authority with responsibility for administration of the school", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "may not receive services at discount rates under paragraph (1)(B)"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "An elementary or secondary school described in clause (i), or the school board, local educational agency, or other authority with responsibility for administration of the school, shall provide reasonable public notice and hold at least one public hearing or meeting to address the proposed Internet safety policy.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "An elementary or secondary school described in clause (i), or the school board, local educational agency, or other authority with responsibility for administration of the school", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "provide reasonable public notice and hold at least one public hearing or meeting"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "In the case of an elementary or secondary school other than an elementary school or a secondary school as defined in section 7801 of title 20, the notice and hearing required by this clause may be limited to those members of the public with a relationship to the school.", "force": "permission", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "definition", "term": "certification under this subparagraph", "text": "A certification under this subparagraph is a certification that the school, school board, local educational agency, or other authority with responsibility for administration of the school-"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "A certification under this subparagraph is a certification that the school, school board, local educational agency, or other authority with responsibility for administration of the school- (i) is enforcing a policy of Internet safety for minors that includes monitoring the online activities of minors and the operation of a technology protection measure with respect to any of its computers with Internet access that protects against access through such computers to visual depictions that are- (I) obscene; (II) child pornography; or (III) harmful to minors;", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the school, school board, local educational agency, or other authority with responsibility for administration of the school", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "A certification under this subparagraph is a certification that the school, school board, local educational agency, or other authority with responsibility for administration of the school- (ii) is enforcing the operation of such technology protection measure during any use of such computers by minors; and", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the school, school board, local educational agency, or other authority with responsibility for administration of the school", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "A certification under this subparagraph is a certification that the school, school board, local educational agency, or other authority with responsibility for administration of the school- (iii) as part of its Internet safety policy is educating minors about appropriate online behavior, including interacting with other individuals on social networking websites and in chat rooms and cyberbullying awareness and response.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the school, school board, local educational agency, or other authority with responsibility for administration of the school", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
